text: The Patriots head to Jacksonville this Sunday for a Week 3 matchup against the Jaguars at Everbank Stadium, coming off a gritty 20-3 victory over the Steelers where their defense dominated in man coverage and TreVeyon Henderson scored a rushing touchdown, even as the offense continues searching for the rhythm that fueled last season's Super Bowl run. However, the team absorbed some significant damage in that win: starting right guard Mike Onwenu suffered a broken right ankle that has landed him on injured reserve, prompting the Patriots to sign punter Mitch Wishnowsky from the practice squad to the 53-man roster and add tight end Tanner Conner to the practice squad. Meanwhile, off the field, Patriots legend Adam Vinatieri set a Guinness World Record by converting a field goal at 3,454 meters on the Jungfraujoch in Switzerland, proving that some skills never fade—even if the Patriots' offensive consistency this season hasn't quite matched last year's championship pedigree.
